semiconductor_relevance: Medium — V-TEX Korea provides critical vacuum system components essential for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: V-TEX Korea specializes in the production of vacuum valves and rupture discs, which are crucial for maintaining contamination-free environments in semiconductor manufacturing. Their products, such as the APC Penduroll Valve and the True L-Motion Valve, are designed to minimize vibration and particle generation, supporting the stringent requirements of advanced semiconductor processes.
capabilities: APC Penduroll Valve with zero conductance
True L-Motion Valve with zero particle generation
Electric True L-Motion Valve minimizing vibration
